## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem and what this change lets the user do.

## Related issue or roadmap item

Link an issue or list the relevant roadmap ID. State remaining work for partial implementations.

## Validation

List the commands and actual Windows scenarios checked. For UI changes, include Windows build, display topology/DPI, launch mode, and before/after evidence where available. Identify anything not tested.

- [ ] Formatting and relevant automated checks pass, or failures are explained.
- [ ] Native desktop/window state is preserved and restored where affected.
- [ ] Layout, hit targets, scrolling, and keyboard behavior were checked where affected.
- [ ] Documentation and pilot-status claims match the resulting behavior.

## Limitations or follow-up

Describe known gaps, app/device compatibility, and any Windows-settings handoff.
